packageRules.description: ESLint v10 is not compatible with the current frontend lint setup. Keep ESLint packages on v9 until the config is migrated.

CHUB's own image. A digest pin on our own :latest chases every merge to main forever (9 auto-merged bump PRs in 3 days) and each develop-side merge edits the shared compose.yaml, failing the Develop Invariant Guard. The compose example stays on bare :latest; do not pin or update it.
Shared files on develop change only via the main->develop sync merge; a renovate PR merged to develop edits them directly and fails the Develop Invariant Guard. Updates reach develop through main.
The one dependency file that exists only on develop (CL2K extension), so renovate may update it there.
